---

The county's handwritten probate will books for Schuylkill County, Pennsylvania, were browsed — two small digitized film groups covering roughly 1851 to 1930, together holding 33 page images. A will in the name of Thomas Flynn was found in the first film: he was of Minersville in Schuylkill County, signed his will in March 1889, and it was proved in court in April 1889. The will names his wife Margaret, his son John, and his daughter Mary Ann Dougherty — but does not mention a son named Patrick. Most other images in both films turned out to be duplicate scans of a single unrelated will, suggesting these are sample excerpts rather than a full run of will books.

The found will is ready to be handed to the extraction step (record-structurer agent) to add it as a source; however, because Patrick Flynn is not named in it, this record neither confirms nor rules out the Thomas Flynn parentage hypothesis — it may be a different Thomas Flynn, or Patrick may have been excluded, or pre-deceased his father's will date.
